purpose: Educational real-data frame GNN, not production GraphEPV
goal_label: same-team goal-shot within next 10 seconds, period-censored; aligned goal markers/shot labels reconciled to final score
label_limitations: Four source matches excluded by score audit. Goal timing and shot identity not video-verified. Positive states overlap in goal windows.
architecture: 23 nodes; 9 current-frame features; radius 20m plus ball links/self loops; row-normalized adjacency; tanh(A X W + X U + b); separate attack/defense/ball mean pools; logistic head
optimizer: Adam, unweighted BCE, L2=1e-5, batch512, learning_rate0.003, max150 epochs, validation log-loss patience20
calibration: positive-slope affine logit calibration fitted to validation matches only, recomputed by notebook
sampling: training/evaluation snapshots every20 native10Hz frames; animation applies frozen model to denser held-out states
limitation: Three test matches, 16 positive states; not a benchmark or proof of graph advantage. Brier score is worse than prevalence baseline.
retraining: Set RETRAIN=True in notebooks/methods/16_graph_epv.ipynb. All training code is inline.
